title: Mindustry-C configuration
description: Target version, compile options and the memory layout of the Mindustry-C program. Lives in ~/.mindustry-c/mlgc.json and may be overridden per project by <workspace>/.vscode/mlgc.json.

activeConfiguration.description: Name of the configuration to use. The workspace file may override this.

configurations.description: One entry per build target. The first one is used if activeConfiguration names nothing.

targetVersion.description: Mindustry version the output runs on. Gates which instructions and language features are emitted. The compiler defaults to 154.3.

includePaths.description: Extra directories searched by #include, after the including file's own directory.

memoryBlocks.description: The memory cells and banks the program may use. ORDER IS SIGNIFICANT: the nth block here is bound to the nth memory building the processor finds among its links, so it must match the order you wired up in the map.

compilerOptions.description: Defaults for the pragmas that tune code generation. A #pragma in the source still wins over these.

array.description: Default for #pragma optimize(array): keep arrays in registers instead of memory.

constArray.description: Default for the third argument of #pragma optimize(array): also optimise arrays that are never written.

pointer.description: Default for #pragma optimize(pointer): store the name of a pointee instead of its address. Requires targetVersion >= 150 and forbids pointer arithmetic on those pointers.

structPointerThreshold.description: Default for #pragma optimize(struct_pointer, n): largest struct, in registers, that a pointer may carry by name. Memory is used for anything bigger.

stackCheck.description: Default for #pragma stackcheck(fn): called when a stack frame cannot grow. Empty means do not check capacity at all.

stackUnderflow.description: Default for #pragma stackunderflow(fn): called when the stack is walked below the first block. Empty means do not check.

noInline.description: Default for #pragma noinline: functions that are never inlined automatically. An explicit inline keyword outranks this.

idOverrides.description: Content ids for a processor whose ordering differs from the built-in table. Equivalent to #pragma id(category, @name: id).

idMap.description: Maps @name to an id in this category.

name.description: Becomes a link variable in the generated code (<name>_id), so it must be a valid Mindustry identifier and unique within the configuration.

size.description: Capacity in bytes. A memory cell holds 64, a memory bank 256, a world cell 256.

building.description: The in-game building this block corresponds to. Informational: it suggests a size and documents the wiring.

note.description: Free text: where this block is wired in the map.
